ledger.claim: No rider-requested detour can be made out. POL-RD-04 requires an instruction from the rider in the chat_log; EV-CHAT-02857 records message_count 0 with no first or last message time, so there is no instruction to corroborate — not even one that fails the waypoint test. The clause is simply unavailable on this record and no distance is excluded from the excess on its account.

No relocation adjustment applies. Under POL-RD-05 the baseline is re-cut only where pickup or dropoff was amended after booking; EV-TRIP-02857 shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at both null, original_pickup and original_dropoff both null, and amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min both null. The 14.4 km booked optimal therefore remains the baseline and no pre-amendment distance is creditable to the driver.

This is not a pooled trip. POL-RD-12 re-bases the threshold test on a matched-itinerary optimal only where trip_record.vehicle_type is RYDE_POOL; EV-TRIP-02857 records vehicle_type RYDE_X and solo_optimal_distance_km null. The pooled baseline the clause creates does not exist here, so the 14.4 km booked optimal is the correct comparator and the 4.72 km excess is undiluted.

The fare is METERED, so POL-RD-02 runs and the distance-and-time refund route is open. EV-FARE-02857 records fare_model METERED and quoted_fare_sgd null, so POL-RD-11 — which closes the distance refund on an upfront-quoted trip — does not apply to this trip and cannot be used to deny the rider the recomputation below.

The POL-RD-02 recomputation is arithmetic and points one way. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 14.4 + 0.28 x 19.4) x 1.0 + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP on the optimal route + 0 fixed surcharges + 0 waiting_time_fee - 0 promo_discount = 20.832. The surge multiplier is read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier on EV-FARE-02857, where it is 1.0; the trip_record carries no such field and none was inferred. Refund = charged_total 25.93 - recomputed_fare 20.832 = 5.098, which rounds UP to SGD 5.10.

Neither limiting rule disturbs that figure. The refund of 5.098 is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis in POL-RD-02, so NO_ACTION cannot be taken; and 5.098 is 19.66% of charged_total, far below the 90% share at which the clause would convert the outcome to FULL_REFUND. The correct remedy is therefore PARTIAL_REFUND of 5.10 against the 25.93 charged, not the 9.50 the rider asks for.

No pass-through adjustment is added or subtracted. POL-RD-09(1) provides that where a deviation is refunded under POL-RD-02, off-route ERP is already comprehended in that refund and must never be added on top of it; here EV-FARE-02857 itemises no ERP gantries at all (erp_lines total 0.00, tolls_erp 0.0), no airport surcharge, and no unmatched charge line that could support a POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity correction. The ruling should itemise the zero ERP total for transparency and then leave the POL-RD-02 figure untouched.

PARTIAL_REFUND is a real rider win on these facts. The rider filed this dispute, and under POL-GEN-03 the ruling values are defined against the filing party: EV-FARE-02857 shows payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.0, so the present state is that the rider carries the whole 25.93. A partial refund of 5.10 is money returned to the rider and reduces the charge they carry; NO_ACTION, by contrast, would leave that charge exactly where it is.

I concede the rider's stated ground and do not press it. ledger.claim: On this trip's own trace the excess is 4.72 km and 32.78 percent of the 14.4 km booked optimal. That clears the POL-RD-01 establishment gates of 0.8 km and 20 percent, but sits below both materiality gates of 8.0 km and 50 percent, so the deviation is established and NOT material - and materiality is the only condition that engages the POL-RD-06 driver_profile check on this trip. The remedy is therefore confined to the POL-RD-02 arithmetic; a 4.72 km overshoot on a 25-minute metered trip is not the serial-misconduct case the rider's claim asserts.

The most the rider can recover is SGD 5.10, and the fare ledger proves it: recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 14.4 + 0.28 x 19.4) x 1.0 (the surge multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee = 20.8320; refund = charged_total 25.93 - 20.8320 = 5.0980, rounded UP to SGD 5.10. That is 19.66 percent of charged_total - above the 0.50 de minimis, so a refund is due rather than NO_ACTION, but far below the 90 percent share that would convert it into a full refund. The rider's 9.50 figure has no line of the fare_breakdown behind it.

Nothing may be added on top of that figure. The ledger carries no ERP or toll lines at all - on-optimal-route and off-optimal-route ERP both 0.00 - and no airport surcharge on a trip that does not originate at an airport, so no POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity correction and no POL-RD-09 pass-through refund arises. The billed distance of 19.1 km matches the trace's 19.12 km to within 20 metres, so the rider was not billed for distance the vehicle did not drive. The rider's recovery is the difference against the optimal route and nothing more.

Nothing else in the bundle supports a remedy beyond that arithmetic. There is no chat log for the trip - 0 messages, so no rider instruction of any kind was recorded - and the bundle's only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-02857-01, is IMPAIRED BY ABSENCE: it carries no payload, its admissibility weight_multiplier is 0.0 and its issue code is MISSING_ARTIFACT with severity BLOCKING, so it can establish no fact for either party and the POL-RD-03 advisory comparison cannot be run on this record. The driver's contemporaneous account of traffic therefore stands unrefuted by any artifact in the bundle, but the driver does not ask the tribunal to assume a closure the record never records: the rider's case is the trace excess, and the trace excess is fully answered by the POL-RD-02 arithmetic figure.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties. This was a metered RYDE_X trip, TRP-02857, driven on 2026-09-09. The booked optimal route was 14.4 km (EV-TRIP-02857). The governing measurement is the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02857, weight 1.0), which records 19.12 km against the booked optimal, an excess of 4.72 km, or 32.78%. Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass (above 0.8 km and above 20%), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED; neither materiality gate (8.0 km, 50%) is met, so it is not a MATERIAL deviation. The trace itself is unimpaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: 151 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps and no jump over 500 m, so the deviation rests on the trace alone (POL-RD-08(b)) and no POL-RD-07(ii)/POL-RD-10(3) corroboration question arises. The triad EV-TRIP-02857 / EV-GPS-02857 / EV-FARE-02857 all carry trip_id TRP-02857 with matching timing, so POL-RD-08(a) is satisfied. No exculpatory clause applies: EV-CHAT-02857 has 0 messages (POL-RD-04 has no instruction to test), no pickup or dropoff amendment exists (POL-RD-05), and the vehicle is RYDE_X with no pooled itinerary (POL-RD-12). POL-RD-11 does not apply because the fare is METERED with quoted_fare_sgd null, so POL-RD-02 runs. The arithmetic, read off EV-FARE-02857: recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 14.4 + 0.28 x 19.4) x 1.0 surge multiplier (read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee = 20.832; charged_total 25.93; refund = 25.93 - 20.832 = 5.098, rounded UP to SGD 5.10. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis (so not NO_ACTION) and 19.66% of charged_total, far below the 90% share that would make it a full refund. No ERP, toll or airport surcharge lines exist in the ledger, so no POL-RD-09 pass-through or billing-integrity correction is added. On the rider's stated ground: the 'six deviation flags' cited in the claim is driver_profile.prior_deviation_flags, a lifetime counter that POL-GEN-01 marks CONTEXT ONLY and forbids as a ground of decision; the counter POL-RD-06 names, deviation_flags_90d, is 0 against 260 completed trips in the trailing window, so no repeat pattern is established and neither the POL-RD-06(b) full-refund uplift nor the POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral is available. On the driver's explanation of 'Traffic.': no traffic advisory covers this trip - EV-ADVIS-02857-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT - and under POL-RD-13 that assertion cites no artifact, so it is a gap in the bundle rather than a contradiction, POL-RD-03 cannot be run, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. No POL-RD-10 escalation trigger fires. Two rider claims were discarded before the debate: both cited the impaired advisory EV-ADVIS-02857-01 (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) without disclosing the impairment as POL-GEN-02(1) requires. The monetary effect (SGD 5.10) does not exceed the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so this provisional ruling is executed automatically subject to appeal under POL-GEN-04. The 25.93 charged stands except for the 5.10 returned to the rider.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
